free_tier.stated: No published total quota. Per-object table is published and slightly tighter than Salsa: max attachment 12 MiB, import 300 MiB, job artifact 250 MiB, page 250 MiB, snippet 50 MiB, import remote file 10 GiB, download file 5 GiB. Registry: Conan 3 GiB, Maven 3 GiB, PyPI 3 GiB, Terraform 1 GiB, npm/NuGet 500 MiB, Helm 5 MiB.

retention.stated: per-object-cap: 250 MiB CI artifacts (vs Salsa's 750 MiB), 5 GiB download file. retention: indefinite for published projects

egress.terms: Free; Framasoft-funded, no billing, downloads served from the instance.

tooling: Standard GitLab: git over SSH/HTTPS, Generic Package API, CI. No rclone backend.
chaining: unlimited projects x 5 GiB/download file (and 3 GiB per registry artifact) x unlimited versions. Same shape as Salsa with a lower artifact ceiling.

reliability_note: Registration sits behind an Anubis proof-of-work wall ('Making sure you're not a bot!', Anubis v1.28.2, modified by Framasoft) - so signup is not scriptable at all, which is a stronger anti-farming gate than Salsa's human queue. The instance-configuration page itself was readable, so limits are auditable; only signup is walled.
